recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochromatic portrait with a heavy halftone dot pattern and distressed paper texture. The subject is a smiling man in a vehicle, illuminated by a strong side light source that creates deep shadows and bright highlights, evoking a nostalgic, Americana aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the light source
Halftone dot density correlating with shadow depth
Text anchored in the lower-left corner against a dark background
Distressed grit overlaying both image and typography
coreInvariants: Uniform halftone dot screen across the entire image
Muted cream and dark charcoal color palette
Strong chiaroscuro lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject centered horizontally but leaning toward the left, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright face, follow the arm to the left, then drop down to the high-contrast text in the bottom corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured shadows in the lower half provide a stable base for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for shadows and halftone dots.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream/off-white for highlights and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange for the secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; the image relies on tonal range rather than color.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, consistent stroke weights for the primary name
Rounded terminals on specific glyphs like 'c' and 'e'
Secondary text is all-caps with wider tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower-case 'y' with a short, rounded descender

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over dark shadow area for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and case contrast within the same typeface family or similar geometric skeletons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and heavy weight of the primary text.
Provides a similar modern-yet-timeless geometric feel with excellent weight variety.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man smiling inside a vintage truck cabin. Apply a heavy halftone dot filter and a sepia/cream and charcoal duotone effect. Overlay with a layer of white dust, scratches, and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of stacked bold geometric sans-serif text in cream in the bottom-left corner. Below that, add a single line of all-caps text in burnt orange with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible across the entire image?
Is the text left-aligned and positioned in the bottom-left quadrant?
Does the color palette consist only of cream, charcoal, and orange?
Is the lighting on the subject's face high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Exact wording of the artist name
postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone dots don't obscure the text legibility.
Ensure the orange text is clearly distinct from the cream text.
Verify the 'worn paper' texture feels integrated, not just a flat overlay.
Confirm the subject's face is the brightest part of the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a [halftone screen] to a [high-contrast portrait] using a [cream and charcoal] palette, then anchor [bold geometric sans-serif] typography in the [bottom-left] with a [burnt orange] subtitle.
